mode.description: Collector output is attributed to parsed command clauses.

status_model.description: Execution-status attribution model used by this artifact.

telemetry_quality.description: Artifact-wide telemetry quality after loss, cleanup, and per-call checks.

collection_validity.description: Whether the artifact passed collector integrity validation.

merged_rss_reason.description: ok for a dense aligned sampled estimate, observed_sparse_lower_bound for an available conservative single-address-space observation, or the reason RSS is unavailable. Kernel RSS counter approximation still applies.

memory_reduction.description: Sparse coverage uses the largest actually observed single address-space value without temporal interpolation or asynchronous summation. Dense coverage retains the aligned held-sample aggregate.

state.description: Observed execution outcome for this clause.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when state is exited.

signal.description: Terminating signal number when state is signaled.

succeeded.description: Normalized success result, or null when no reliable result exists.

reason.description: Why execution status is missing, unavailable, or nonstandard.

source.description: Evidence source used to determine clause status.

bin.description: Normalized executable or shell builtin name.

argv.description: Parsed argument vector for the clause.

censored.description: The execution ended before ordinary completion. Partial measurements remain available for learning; this flag records their outcome quality.

confirmed_timeout.description: Explicit timeout evidence, separate from an unclassified signal or cancellation.

stdin_from_pipe.description: Optional evidence that stdin comes from the upstream pipe. Absent or null means unknown; downstream position alone is insufficient.

status.description: Clause execution outcome and its evidence source.

cpu_ns_cumulative.description: Cumulative CPU time for the clause in nanoseconds (the collector's raw key).

peak_cpu_cores.description: Maximum fixed-window CPU utilization in cores when eligible.

peak_memory_mb.description: Sampled process-lineage RSS in decimal megabytes; sparse coverage reports the largest observed single address-space value as a conservative lower bound, with reduction and quality in provenance.

provenance.description: Measurement and mapping evidence, including the RSS reduction and coverage quality.

network_rx_bytes.description: Attributed received bytes; currently null because clause network collection is not implemented.

network_tx_bytes.description: Attributed transmitted bytes; currently null because clause network collection is not implemented.

availability.description: Per-target quality reasons. Stable target keys are latency, cpu_time, cpu, memory, disk_io, and status; diagnostic details may expand. Partial numeric observations are retained even when timeout or incomplete mapping makes quality unknown.

bin.description: Parsed executable or builtin that produced no runtime exec image.

argv.description: Parsed arguments for the non-executed clause.

status.description: Evidence explaining why the clause did not execute.

peak_cpu_cores.description: Maximum CPU utilization in cores after summing all owned exec-image contributions in aligned 500 ms windows.

sampled_peak_rss_mb.description: Dense sampled RSS is summed across distinct live address spaces in aligned bins. Sparse coverage reports the largest observed single address-space value as a conservative lower bound. Units are decimal megabytes; provenance identifies the reduction.

provenance.description: Call-level reduction evidence, including RSS coverage quality.

availability.description: Per-target quality of the call-level CPU and sampled RSS peaks. Timeout and incomplete mapping preserve already observed numeric values alongside an unknown:<reason> diagnostic; a null value means the metric itself is missing.

cpu.description: ok or an unknown:<reason> value for the call-level CPU peak.

memory.description: ok or an unknown:<reason> value for the call-level RSS peak.

command.description: Original command associated with this telemetry record.

telemetry_quality.description: Quality of this call's mapping and measurements.

eligible_for_kb.description: Collector completeness diagnostic retained for compatibility. The shared ingestion policy retains observed partial measurements and zero-fills missing metrics rather than discarding this call solely on this flag.

censored.description: The execution ended before ordinary completion. Observed partial values remain usable and the outcome is retained as provenance.

confirmed_timeout.description: Explicit timeout evidence; an arbitrary signal or cancellation alone does not establish a timeout threshold.

timeout_duration_lower_bound_ms.description: Confirmed tool-execution timeout lower bound in milliseconds, when available. This is not an unrelated setup or whole-benchmark time budget.

call_resource.description: Call-level peak metrics reduced from aligned profiles across all mapped exec images.

no_runtime_exec.description: Parsed clauses proven not to have produced a runtime exec image.
